checks.name: Mixed greeting does not swallow farming question
checks.text:
DOCUMENTED SOURCE GUIDE
What do the water numbers mean?

Crop ET describes estimated evapotranspiration. Effective rainfall is the part of rain used by the screening model. Net irrigation also accounts for the stated root-zone storage assumptions. Delivered irrigation divides net irrigation by application efficiency. One millimetre over one hectare is 10 cubic metres. These are screening estimates, not metered water use.

checks.name: Following historical question remains functional
checks.text:
LEARNED HISTORICAL PATTERN
July 2023 · Hot, wetter months

This complete NASA POWER month was held out of fitting. Its nearest learned center is a descriptive assignment for the Punjab regional point, not a crop recommendation.

Mean daily minimum 27.01 °C; mean daily maximum 35.59 °C.
Monthly precipitation 259.09 mm; 19.35% of days had less than 1 mm rainfall.
Coverage 31/31 complete days. Standardized distance 1.53; not a confidence score.
Regional MERRA-2/POWER meteorology (~0.5° × 0.63° grid), not a field sensor. Model power-monthly-kmeans-1.0.0.
